entry.name: actionsEnabled
entry.label: Show the service controls (start, stop, restart, run now).

entry.name: confirmStop
entry.label: Ask for a second click before stopping the service.

entry.name: showTrayText
entry.label: Show the pending upload count next to the tray icon.

entry.name: trayIndicator
entry.label: How the tray icon carries the state: "state-dot", "icon-swap" or "none".

entry.name: showUploadsRow
entry.label: Show the uploads row (pending, in progress, failed).

entry.name: showWorkerRow
entry.label: Show the worker row (running, next run, last error).

entry.name: showRecoveryRow
entry.label: Show the recovery row (tidy state and last batch).

entry.name: showDiskRow
entry.label: Show the disk row (free space and the download floor).

entry.name: showFooter
entry.label: Show the footer with the last update time and the next check countdown.
